content_sections.heading: MNSS Rai Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 3 posts are to be filled - 2 Clerk and 1 Steno-Typist. Category-wise break-up is given below. Here, DSC refers to the Deprived Scheduled Caste category as mentioned in the official notice. Note: The competent authority may increase, decrease, withdraw, or cancel the number of vacancies at any time.

content_sections.heading: MNSS Rai Clerk & Steno-Typist Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Passed 10+2 examination. Matric with Hindi/Sanskrit, or a higher qualification with Hindi as one of the subjects. Selected candidates must pass the State Eligibility Test in Computer Appreciation and Applications (SETC) within the probation period of two years, extendable by one more year. No increment will be given until the SETC test is cleared; failure to qualify may lead to termination of services. Passed 10+2 examination. Hindi Shorthand speed of 64 words per minute, with transcription at 11 words per minute. English Shorthand speed of 80 words per minute, with transcription at 15 words per minute. Matric with Hindi/Sanskrit, or a higher qualification with Hindi as one of the subjects. Must pass the SETC test within the probation period of two years (extendable by one year), on the same terms as applicable to the Clerk post.

content_sections.heading: MNSS Rai Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must be between 18 and 42 years as on the last date of submission of the application form. Age relaxation is applicable as per Haryana Government norms (specific relaxation figures are not mentioned in the notification). Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.text: The exact in-hand monthly salary amount in rupees is not specified in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: MNSS Rai Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates belonging to BC(A), DSC, and UR categories must submit the application online and pay an application fee of ₹200/- , payable in favour of the Principal & Director, MNSS, Rai , payable at Sonipat.

content_sections.heading: MNSS Rai Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for the post of Clerk will be based on a Written Test, conducted as per the norms prescribed by the Government of Haryana. Selection for the post of Steno-Typist will be based on a Written Test, followed by a Shorthand Test and Typing Test in both Hindi and English. In case of a tie in marks, preference will be given to the candidate who is older in age, as determined by the Date of Birth (DOB).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for MNSS Rai Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Completed online application form (printout) Recent passport-size photograph Self-attested copies of certificates and mark sheets Experience certificates, if applicable Incomplete applications, or applications submitted without the required documents, will be rejected. Applications submitted on plain paper will also not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for MNSS Rai Clerk & Steno-Typist Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official website: www.mnssrai.com . Fill and submit the prescribed application form online on or before the applicable last date. Upload a recent passport-size photograph along with self-attested copies of certificates, mark sheets, and experience certificates (if applicable). Pay the application fee of ₹200/- as per the instructions on the portal. After submitting the online form, take a printout of the completed application. Send the printout, along with self-attested copies of all relevant documents, by Registered Post/Speed Post to: O/o Principal & Director, Motilal Nehru School of Sports, Rai - 131029, District Sonipat (Haryana). Ensure the hard copy reaches the above address on or before 14.08.2026, as late submissions will not be considered.
